subject.title: Create example OpenClaw plugin using before_install

question: Should ClawScan host an OpenClaw `before_install` example plugin in this repository, or should that package remain off-main or external until the plugin boundary is settled?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested example, the off-main branch has candidate work, and VISION.md gives both a transparency reason to consider it and a scope guardrail that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor isolated repo example
options.body: Land a focused package/docs PR in this repo only with real OpenClaw `before_install` proof and no public ClawScan CLI changes.

options.title: Keep it external for now
options.body: Leave this issue open as product context or close later only after maintainers decide the plugin should live as a separate OpenClaw or ClawHub package.

recommendation.title: Sponsor isolated repo example
recommendation.body: Land a focused package/docs PR in this repo only with real OpenClaw `before_install` proof and no public ClawScan CLI changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is both the default code owner in CODEOWNERS and the author of the off-main plugin candidate history.
